sql.installerDashboard.getRegionalManagers: select up.org_id as positionId, concat(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) AS full_name from flow.user u inner join flow.user_position up on u.id = up.user_id inner join flow.org o on o.id = up.org_id where up.position_id = 69 and case when (:isParent) then company_id = :parentCompanyId else company_id = :companyId end order by full_name
sql.installerDashboard.getInstallationCrew: select id as positionId, org_name AS full_name from flow.org where parent_org_id = :orgId and archived = false and active_flag = true and case when (:isParent) then company_id = :parentCompanyId else company_id = :companyId end
sql.installerDashboard.getDashboardValues:
select json_build_object( 'substantialCompletions', (select (select count(*) from brs.project_details pd where substantial_completion_date between :startDate::date and :endDate::date AND pd.installation_resource = :crewId ) as substantialCompletions) ::numeric(10,2),
'sameWeekCloseout', (select coalesce((select count(*) from brs.project_details pd where (installation_start_time::date between :startDate::date and :endDate::date AND ((substantial_completion_date is not null AND substantial_completion_date::date between installation_start_time::date - 7 and installation_start_time::date + 7) OR (substantial_completion_date is null AND (now() at time zone 'US/Mountain')::date between installation_start_time::date - 7 and installation_start_time::date + 7) ) AND pd.installation_resource = :crewId)) ::numeric(10,2) / NULLIF(((select count(*) from brs.project_details pd where installation_start_time::date between :startDate::date and :endDate::date AND pd.installation_resource = :crewId) ::numeric(10,2)),0),0)) ::numeric(10,2),
'onTimeCloseout', (select coalesce((select count(*) from brs.project_details pd where (installation_start_time::date between :startDate::date and :endDate::date AND ( (substantial_completion_date is not null AND installation_start_time::date = substantial_completion_date::date) OR (substantial_completion_date is null AND installation_start_time::date = (now() at time zone 'US/Mountain')::date)) ) AND pd.installation_resource = :crewId) ::numeric(10,2) / NULLIF(((select count(*) from brs.project_details pd where installation_start_time::date between :startDate::date and :endDate::date AND pd.installation_resource = :crewId) ::numeric(10,2)),0),0)) ::numeric(10,2),
'inspectionApproval', (select coalesce((select count(*) from brs.project_details pd where (installation_start_time::date between :startDate::date and :endDate::date AND ( (substantial_completion_date is not null AND installation_start_time::date = substantial_completion_date::date) OR (substantial_completion_date is null AND installation_start_time::date = (now() at time zone 'US/Mountain')::date)) ) AND pd.installation_resource = :crewId) ::numeric(10,2) / NULLIF(((select count(*) from brs.project_details pd where installation_start_time::date between :startDate::date and :endDate::date AND pd.installation_resource = :crewId) ::numeric(10,2)),0),0)) ::numeric(10,2), 'projectIds', (select array_agg(project_id) from brs.project_details pd where substantial_completion_date between :startDate::date and :endDate::date AND pd.installation_resource = :crewId) )
